nodes.description: Total token supply state variable of contract eKiddo.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances, written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing allowances, written in approve and transferFrom.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Token decimals value set in the constructor.
Constructor initialising metadata, _totalSupply and crediting balances[msg.sender].
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from balances[msg.sender] to balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and debits allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
Checked addition helper requiring c >= a.
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a.
Checked multiplication helper requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0.
Caller-controlled address used as balance and allowance mapping key.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply (no SafeMath, no underflow guard).
Allowance debit allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) inside transferFrom, keyed by untrusted msg.sender without an explicit allowance check.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, the debited address.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, the credited address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance.
Parameter 'a' (minuend) of SafeMath.safeSub.
Parameter 'b' (subtrahend) of SafeMath.safeSub.
Parameter 'a' of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Parameter 'b' of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Return variable 'c' holding the result of a - b in SafeMath.safeSub.
Return variable 'c' holding the result of a + b in SafeMath.safeAdd.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _totalSupply = 100000000000000000000000000.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the entire supply based on caller identity.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
msg.sender determines who receives the initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], authorization derives from caller identity.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] and trusts the caller identity for allowances.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for the spender.
spender parameter is the second key used in approved[msg.sender][spender].
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd results.
tokens parameter flows into the balance arithmetic of transfer.
to parameter is used as the credit key in transfer.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
subtrahend parameter b of safeSub.
minuend parameter a of safeSub.
local c holds a - b in safeSub and is validated by require(b <= a).
second operand b of safeAdd.
first operand a of safeAdd.
local c holds a + b in safeAdd and is validated by require(c >= a).
transferFrom writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom mutates the allowance entry allowed[from][msg.sender].
tokens parameter drives the debit amounts in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit key in transferFrom.
from parameter is the debit key in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub twice for balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance.
transferFrom performs the allowance debit operation keyed by msg.sender.
Allowance debit writes the allowed mapping.
msg.sender supplies the spender key of the allowance being debited.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply executes the unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key in balanceOf.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner parameter is the first key in allowance.
spender parameter is the second key in allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only carries data into the transfer function and does not need a standalone node in the normalized graph.
The amount parameter is fully consumed by transfer's safeSub/safeAdd logic.
The 'from' parameter is used only as a balances/allowed key inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is used only as the credit key inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter is consumed by the balance and allowance debits in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
The tokens parameter is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
The lookup key parameter belongs entirely to the balanceOf view function.
The owner key parameter belongs entirely to the allowance view function.
The spender key parameter belongs entirely to the allowance view function.
The minuend operand is part of the checked subtraction implementation.
The subtrahend operand is part of the checked subtraction implementation.
The first operand is part of the checked addition implementation.
The second operand is part of the checked addition implementation.
The intermediate result of a - b is internal to the safeSub arithmetic helper.
The intermediate result of a + b is internal to the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
